saved.description: True only if the image file was written to the requested path.

path.description: The path the image was saved to, relative to the image set directory.

size.description: Pixel dimensions of the generated image, as WIDTHxHEIGHT.

fragments.description: Every prompt file read for this generation, including the top level prompt and each file reached through an @ reference, relative to the image set directory.

error.description: Why the image was not generated. Null when saved is true.
